title: Count Residue Prefixes
summary: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, count how many of its prefixes have a distinct character count that matches the prefix length modulo 3.
statement: Given a string s made of lowercase English letters, count how many of its prefixes have a distinct character count that matches the prefix length modulo 3.
constraints: For each nonempty prefix of s, count its distinct letters.
The prefix qualifies when that count equals the prefix length modulo three.
Return the number of qualifying prefixes.
hints: Maintain a set of letters seen in the growing prefix.
Its size is the current distinct count.
Compare that size with one-based prefix length modulo three.

tests.explanation: Lengths one and two have distinct counts one and two; length three has residue zero, so return two.
Prefixes of lengths one and four qualify, producing two.
